_comment: Tier-2 seed values for the perception substrate. Read by both Python (server/) and GDScript (scripts/). Parity enforced by tests/test_constants_parity.py. Per docs/perception_spec.md and docs/perception_implementation_plan.md, every value here has either a documented decay path or is a defensible tuning parameter. Editing values here is the ONLY supported way to tune the substrate; constants in code are bugs.

embedding_bridge._decay: Bootstrap concepts wash out after ~500 drift cycles via cortical feedback (§4.2). drift_count_persist_threshold gates which neurons survive session boundaries.

hebbian._decay: Reward-gating modifier active at runtime; weights move via Hebbian rule per §2.4.

neurogenesis_thresholds._decay: Spawn rates, not content. Affect how quickly the being develops new neurons, not what those neurons represent (§4.5).

sensors._decay: Physical body constraints. Treat as Tier 1 for default beings; listed here only for scenario-specific experiments (§4.6).

capacity._decay: Capacity caps. Not decaying. Tunable per experiment.

reward_magnitudes._decay: F8 magnitude-sensitivity gate verifies behavior is robust to ±2x perturbation. If gate fails, magnitudes are bypassing reward-gating normalization.

drive_thresholds._doc: Phase 1 drive-crossing detection. Urgency threshold = drive at or above this is 'urgent' (signals reward when crossing back below). Safe band lower = sustained drive at or above this counts toward stabilization. drive_safety is the only inverted drive (high=safe).

_thought_entity_bind_threshold_doc: F2: cosine threshold for binding a thought to an entity-encounter. Filters out ambient thoughts (back pain, hunger) that would otherwise poison identity-appraisal. Phase 5.
_identity_filter_min_rejection_rate_doc: F2 acceptance gate: fraction of thought-entity association attempts that must be REJECTED by the name-or-cosine filter for the filter to be 'doing work' (not pass-through). If rejection rate falls below this in trace audits, the filter thresholds are too permissive and identity-appraisals will collapse. Phase 5.
_h_min_attention_entropy_factor_doc: F6: H_MIN = factor * log(K). Rolling 10-min mean attention entropy must exceed this floor or the stability gate fails (tunnel vision). Phase 6+.
_n_fallback_retire_doc: F4: cold-start verb-grammar fallback contribution decays as max(0, 1 - compound_count / N). At N compound neurons, fallback is zero. Phase 7.

training_maturity._decay: F5: Phase 8 trace harvest accepts only post-maturity thoughts. Synthetic-to-replay weighting prevents overfitting to whatever cold-start beings happened to do.

_magnitude_sensitivity_max_kl_doc: F8 gate: verb-distribution KL between baseline and 2x-magnitude beings must stay below this after 10 simulated minutes.
_semantic_probe_min_pass_rate_doc: F1 hard gate: fraction of semantic-neighborhood probes (~30 probes) where ≥1 expected neighbor is in top-10. Below threshold → T0 produces lexical noise → Phase 0.5 (T1) mandatory.
